highlights: Backdrop blur effect on navigation: 'backdrop-blur-xs' creates frosted glass effect on sticky header
Soft shadow on product panels: 'shadow-lg' and 'hover:shadow-md' for depth and interactivity
Panel border gradient treatment: 1px gradient border from full opacity to 50% opacity creates subtle depth
Raised button shadow: 'shadow-[var(--button-shadow-raised)]' adds elevation to primary CTAs
Toast notification shadow: 'box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) 0px 4px 12px' for floating UI elements
Dashboard preview shadow: 'shadow-lg' on rounded container with border creates realistic depth
Customer story cards: Inset shadow 'box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.12)' creates subtle inner border glow on gradient backgrounds
Visual overlay fade: Linear gradient overlay on Realtime panel creates seamless content fade from transparent to surface-75
Animated marquee effect: File type icons in Storage panel use CSS animation for continuous scrolling
Blur transitions: Multiple elements use 'filter:blur()' with opacity for progressive disclosure effects
